figure: FIGURE 19.1 — The agent loop: a four-state machine
issue: The figure's legend states a different bounding mechanism from the caption's central claim. Caption: "Plan, Execute, Observe, Decide whose turn context budget, not the model's judgment, prevents an infinite loop." Figure legend: "resolved -> final answer; no resolution within the turn limit -> stopped", and the terminal edge is labelled "limit hit" with the box reading "limit / terminal". Nothing in the figure depicts a context or token budget; a reader who reads only the figure will conclude the loop is bounded by a turn counter, not by the context budget — the exact distinction the caption is making. The figure also omits the mechanism (context accumulation) that makes the budget bind.
evidence: Rendered page 336: legend line "resolved -> final answer; no resolution within the turn limit -> stopped"; edge label "limit hit"; amber box "Stopped / limit / terminal". Caption: "whose turn context budget, not the model's judgment, prevents an infinite loop. Assumption: an append-only context from the 9,200-token prompt at 2.62 MB/token KV (FP16)".
acceptance_test: The terminal edge is labelled with the budget (e.g. "context budget exhausted -> stopped") and the legend wording matches the caption's "turn context budget"; alternatively the caption is reworded to "turn limit". A reader can state from the figure alone which resource bounds the loop.
